## Source
.design/m5/49-hardware-token-signing.md — REQ-1, REQ-6, AC-1 + decomposition PR 2.

## Surface
- `polaris-backend/src/labeler/signer/hwtoken.rs` — impl skeleton
- `polaris-backend/src/labeler/signer/hwtoken/pkcs11.rs` — PKCS#11 backend via `cryptoki`
- `polaris-backend/src/labeler/signer/hwtoken/batch.rs` — batch-mode driver scaffold
- `polaris-backend/tests/hwtoken_signing.rs` — softhsm2 fixture test (#[ignore])

## Rust-quality notes
- Impl `SigningKey` for `HwTokenSigningKey`; `sign()` initially returns `WouldBlock` (no daemon connected in batch mode); `public_key()` returns the cached public extracted from the token.
- **PKCS#11 session lifetime**: held by the `polaris labeler-sign-pending` CLI tool, not by the long-lived backend in batch mode. Per rust-quality §10: cryptoki sessions are sync; wrap async callers in `tokio::task::spawn_blocking`.
- **Public-key extraction**: at signer-init time (CLI tool, not backend), call `C_GetAttributeValue(CKA_EC_POINT)` and persist the public key in a Polaris config (or the same `app.bsky.labeler.service`-publishing flow as TPM mode).
- **`secrecy::SecretString` for PINs** — never on disk, never logged. PIN is cached only in the CLI tool's process memory during `polaris labeler-sign-pending`, never in backend memory.
- Per rust-quality §7: softhsm2 fixture test signs payload, verifies via `proto-blue-crypto::verify_signature`.

## External references
- `cryptoki` crate: https://docs.rs/cryptoki/latest/cryptoki/
- softhsm2: https://github.com/opendnssec/SoftHSMv2
- `secrecy`: https://docs.rs/secrecy/latest/secrecy/

## Acceptance (AC-1)
- [ ] softhsm2 fixture test: sign + verify round-trip passes.
- [ ] CI marker `#[ignore]`; runs via `--ignored`.
